page_title: MNU 3-2 NEW | Manchester Utd v Newcastle 15/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
90+7' Manchester Utd take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+7' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Manchester Utd force a corner. They send men into the box.
90+5' A crossfield pass from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) fails to find any of his teammates.

90+2' 3 - 2 Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:2 with this magnificent strike.
90+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Newcastle.
90+1' A cross from Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Good work from Newcastle as they win a corner.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' We are about to witness a subsitution. Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) for Bruno Fernandes.
89' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
88' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.

88' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His header would have probably ended up low in the middle of the goal, but Andre Onana pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
87' Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.
86' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
84' 3 - 1 Fantastic team goal! Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) was set free in the area by Bruno Fernandes and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 3:1.
83' Substitution. Kobbie Mainoo walks off the pitch and Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) comes on as a substitute.
83' Substitution. Alejandro Garnacho makes his way off the pitch and Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) comes on as his replacement.
82' Erik ten Hag has decided to make a change. Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) replaces Amad Diallo.
81' The referee is firm and issues Amad Diallo (Manchester United) a deserved yellow card.
78' Robert Jones shows a yellow card to Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) for his blatant foul.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sean Longstaff leaves the pitch and Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
75' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
75' Casemiro (Manchester United) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester Utd can continue in their attacking effort.
74' 7:8 – the corner kicks stats.

73' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
72' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Andre Onana.

71' The game is interrupted. Casemiro (Manchester United) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. It's a free kick to Newcastle, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
69' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
68' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) has tested the patience of referee Robert Jones and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
68' Newcastle failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

67' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) connects with a cross and heads towards the top left corner of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Newcastle are going to take it.
67' A pass into the box finds Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Andre Onana denies him.

66' What a beautiful long-range strike by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United). He is quite unlucky as his shot flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
66' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
65' A pass into the penalty area from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is intercepted by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Manchester Utd will take a corner.
63' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) replacing Kieran Trippier.
62' Eddie Howe has decided to substitute Jacob Murphy and he is replaced by Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd).
62' Elliot Anderson comes off the pitch to be replaced by Joelinton (Newcastle Utd).
62' Casemiro (Manchester United) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
61' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the roof of the net and forces a good save out of Martin Dubravka.
60' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
57' 2 - 1 Goal! Amad Diallo (Manchester United) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the left post. It's 2:1.
57' The corner is swung in but Manchester Utd can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
57' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.

56' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
54' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Newcastle comes to nothing.
53' OFF THE BAR! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and fires a bullet of a shot that crashes against the crossbar.

52' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the left post is blocked by Martin Dubravka, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
52' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes a short corner kick.
51' The ball is cleared after Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.

49' 1 - 1 Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) meets a perfect cross from Jacob Murphy deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces a low shot into the middle of the goal. The score has changed to 1:1.
48' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
46' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Andre Onana makes a save.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Robert Jones blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) and Kobbie Mainoo attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
45+2' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United).

45+1' A pass lands at the feet of Scott McTominay (Manchester United) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
45' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.

43' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
43' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is about to take a corner kick.

43' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Newcastle.
42' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends it out of play.
42' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Newcastle win a corner.
42' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
42' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Casemiro (Manchester United) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) plants a goal-bound header low towards the middle of the target after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away.
36' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Newcastle, play can continue.
36' Referee Robert Jones makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Newcastle. Let’s see what happens!
35' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
33' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.

31' 1 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
29' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
28' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd). Corner kick. Newcastle will have an opportunity.

27' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball high over the crossbar. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
27' Manchester Utd take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

27' Martin Dubravka pulls off a great save to deny Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester Utd.
25' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
24' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
23' Manchester Utd are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.

21' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Andre Onana was ready and made a save.
21' Referee Robert Jones sees the trip by Jonny Evans (Manchester United) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
20' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
20' There's an opportunity for Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
18' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play and Manchester Utd manage to earn a corner.

16' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
16' Manchester Utd have a corner.

15' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
15' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) tries his luck with a low long-range effort after receiving a precise pass, but Martin Dubravka has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
14' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) heads on.

13' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Martin Dubravka shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
13' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
12' Robert Jones blows his whistle. Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) commits a foul after dangerous play.
11' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

10' Casemiro (Manchester United) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.

9' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
9' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) is penalised for holding. Robert Jones signals a set piece. A free kick has been awarded to Manchester Utd.
8' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
7' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Newcastle force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
5' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Robert Jones saw the whole situation.
2' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
1' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) serves up a nice cross, but Andre Onana punches the ball away.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Newcastle will have the kick-off.
Robert Jones will supervise the game today.
